name: Dear Sir
message: All of our family enjoy Doral, whole cigarettes. Some light hits others. Well flavor. They are all great. Would you please send us some catalogs so we can use our Doral flavor seals? I wonder do you have T-shirts. I have 3 sons and like to wear T-shirts myself. All make Doral their choice. My sons all want a catalog too.
note: Robert Lankford and Michael Lankford and myself have the same address 1630 16th Ave NE Hickory NC 28601
